$schema.description: URI of the JSON Schema used to validate this configuration.

version.description: dropdx version that generated this configuration file.

conventionalCommits.description: Enable Conventional Commits changelog categorization and release commit formatting.

registry.description: Registry URL to use for package publication.

dryRun.description: Simulate the release without performing side effects.

skipGit.description: Skip git commit, tag, and push steps.

skipPublish.description: Skip publishing packages to the registry.

allowDirty.description: Allow running with uncommitted changes in the git working tree.

provenance.description: Generate npm provenance attestations when publishing.

stage.description: Stage package publication for later approval.

forceBump.description: Force a version bump even when the local package version is greater than the registry version.

summary.description: Release summary used in the release commit and changelog.
